title: Webinar Funnels
html:
KenjiAI Webinars let you create and manage Live, On-Demand, and Recurring webinar experiences from the Sites area. You can collect registrations, build webinar funnel pages, connect webinar content or live links, and use Workflows for confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups.

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • Key Features & Benefits
  • Getting Started
  • Live Webinars
  • On Demand Webinars
  • Automations & Reminders
  • Best Practices
  • Troubleshooting
  • Conclusion


Key Features & Benefits


KenjiAI's webinar funnels are built to streamline setup while giving you powerful engagement tools.

  • On-Demand Webinars → Pre-recorded content that can be accessed anytime, perfect for evergreen lead generation.

  • Live Webinars → Host real-time sessions with scheduled dates/times and live interaction.

  • Template Selection → Pre-built registration, confirmation, and broadcast pages to launch faster.

  • Automated Workflows & Reminders → Pre-configured automation recipes for email and SMS reminders and follow-ups, reducing manual work.

  • Recurring Webinars → Repeat webinar sessions on a Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or No Fixed Time schedule.

  • Webinar Cloning → Reuse an existing webinar setup and update details such as the webinar date and time.

  • Webinar Analytics → Review registration, attendance, viewing, and engagement data for Live, On-Demand, and Recurring Webinars.


Getting Started

Accessing Webinar Creation

  1. Login to your KenjiAI account: app.kenjiai.com

  2. Navigate to Sites in the left sidebar

  3. Click Webinars

  4. Select New Webinar Funnel


Initial Setup


Choose the webinar type that matches your use case:

  • Live Webinar — scheduled for a specific date and time.

  • On-Demand Webinar — uses pre-recorded content that attendees can access after registering.

  • Recurring Webinar — repeats according to a configured schedule.


Live Webinars

Overview

Live webinars are real-time presentations where attendees join at a specific date and time.

4-Step Creation Process


Step 1: Webinar Details

  • Webinar Name (Required) — Example: Digital Marketing Mastery Webinar

  • Timezone (Required) — Default: America/New_York (changeable)

  • Date (Required) — Pick a future date

  • Time (Required) — Example: 2:00 PM




Step 2: Select Form

Attendees register via forms created in Sites > Forms.

  • Dropdown Options → Displays all available forms

  • Custom Forms → Create your own with fields like name, email, phone, etc.

  • Lead Capture → Forms sync with your CRM for tracking and automations

  • Automation Trigger → Form submissions also trigger reminder and follow-up workflows (see Automations & Reminders)


Step 3: Live Webinar Link


Enter your streaming link:

  • Zoom → https://zoom.us/j/123456789

  • YouTube Live → https://youtube.com/watch?v=ABC123

  • Other supported webinar or custom links



Step 4: Templates

Choose from pre-designed funnel templates, such as:

  • Blank Live

  • E-Commerce Marketing Live

  • Financial Planning Live

  • DIY Home Remodel Live



On Demand Webinars

Overview

On-Demand webinars are pre-recorded sessions that attendees can access anytime after registering.

4-Step Creation Process

Step 1: Webinar Details

  • Webinar Name (Required) — Example: Content Marketing Mastery - On Demand

  • Note → No timezone, date, or time needed.

Step 2: Select Form

Same as Live Webinars:

  • Choose a form from Sites > Forms

  • Default Example: Marketing Form - Claim Offer

  • Customizable fields to capture the data you need

Step 3: Select Video

Upload or select a pre-recorded video:

  • Supported video formats include:

    • MP4
    • MOV
    • AVI

  • Upload from your computer or select from the media library

  • Required to proceed



Step 4: Templates

Same template library as Live Webinars, optimized for on-demand viewing.

Automations & Reminders

One of the most powerful features of webinar funnels is automation.

  • Pre-Built Workflow Recipe → Each webinar funnel comes with an automation recipe for reminders and follow-ups.

  • Triggers → Registrations (form submissions) automatically start the workflow.

  • Reminders → Email/SMS reminders can be scheduled for Live Webinars (for example, 24 hours before, 1 hour before, 10 minutes before).

  • Follow-Ups → Post-webinar workflows send thank-you emails, replay links, and nurture campaigns.

  • Customization → You can edit workflows via the three-dot menu on your webinar funnel to adjust timing, personalize messages, or add extra steps.

Pro Tip: Align reminder timings with your audience’s habits (for example, B2B audiences respond better to morning reminders, while B2C may need evening prompts).



Best Practices

Live Webinars

  • Test setup before the event

  • Schedule with audience timezones in mind

  • Promote early and often

  • Have a backup plan for technical issues

  • Encourage interaction (chat, polls, Q&A)

On Demand Webinars

  • Use high-quality recordings

  • Keep videos concise (30–60 minutes)

  • Structure content for self-paced learning

  • Keep your media library organized

  • Refresh content periodically

Troubleshooting

Live Webinars

  • Link not working → Verify format & test before event

  • Timezone confusion → Clearly display timezone on registration and confirmation pages

On Demand Webinars

  • Upload fails → Check format, file size, and internet connection

  • Poor video quality → Upload high-resolution versions

Available frequency options include:

  • Daily
  • Weekly
  • Monthly
  • No Fixed Time

You can also end the series after a specified number of sessions or on a selected date.


General

  • Form not capturing leads → Test form integration with CRM

  • Template not loading → Refresh or check connection


Recurring Webinars


Recurring Webinar settings let you repeat webinar sessions without manually creating every occurrence.

To configure a recurring webinar:

  1. Go to Sites → Webinars.

  2. Create a new webinar or open an eligible existing webinar.

  3. Complete the Webinar Details.

  4. Turn on Enable recurring webinar.

  5. Select the recurrence frequency.

  6. Configure the recurrence pattern.

  7. Choose when the webinar series should end.


Conclusion


Use the webinar type that matches your delivery model, then test the registration form, webinar content, funnel pages, and automation before promoting the webinar.

  • Live → Real-time engagement and interaction

  • On Demand → Evergreen, scalable, and flexible access

With built-in templates and automation workflows, you can launch webinars quickly while ensuring attendees receive timely reminders, seamless confirmations, and personalized follow-ups — helping you maximize engagement and conversions with minimal effort.


Frequently Asked Questions


Can I clone an existing webinar?
Yes. KenjiAI supports cloning webinars so you can reuse an existing setup and update details such as the date and time.


Can I create a recurring webinar?
Yes. Recurring Webinars can repeat on Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or No Fixed Time schedules.


Where can I view webinar analytics?
Go to Sites → Analytics → Webinars.


Does an On-Demand Webinar require a scheduled date and time?
No. On-Demand Webinars require webinar content but do not require a fixed webinar date, time, or timezone.
